rec.help: Say the word clearly, on its own, in a normal voice. Press "Record", speak, then press "Stop". The recording is kept on this device.

rec.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser, then try again.
rec.insecure: The microphone only works on a secure address (https or localhost).
